lessons.title: A School Morning
lessons.content:
学习目标
定位文中细节，划出支持答案的原句。

原创短文
Mia gets up at seven on school days. She has bread and milk for breakfast. Her school is near her home, so she walks there with her brother. Classes start at eight. Mia likes English because she enjoys stories. At lunchtime, she talks with her friends. After school, she reads for twenty minutes before dinner.

词汇提示
near：在附近；walk：步行；before：在……之前。

阅读方法
定位人物、时间和地点。so提示因果，不能用自己的通学方式代替短文事实。

自查
先找到答案依据，再用自己的话复述，不要求逐词翻译。

lessons.title: Our Class Library
lessons.content:
学习目标
定位文中细节，划出支持答案的原句。

原创短文
Our class has a small library next to the window. There are picture books, science books and storybooks. On Tuesday afternoons, students can borrow one book each. They must return it the next Tuesday. Ben likes science books, but this week he borrows a storybook for his little sister. He plans to read it with her at home.

词汇提示
borrow：借入；return：归还；plan：计划。

阅读方法
but提示通常偏好和本周选择的区别。要以本周实际借书信息作答。

自查
先找到答案依据，再用自己的话复述，不要求逐词翻译。

lessons.title: A Picnic Plan
lessons.content:
学习目标
定位文中细节，划出支持答案的原句。

原创短文
Leo and his friends plan a picnic for Saturday. They check the weather on Friday evening. It may rain, so they choose a place with a small shelter. Leo brings sandwiches, and Kim brings apples. Everyone brings water. They agree to meet at the park gate at nine. After lunch, they take their rubbish away. They want to leave the park clean.

词汇提示
picnic：野餐；shelter：遮蔽处；gate：大门；rubbish：垃圾。

阅读方法
plan表示计划，may表示可能，不能据此说星期六一定下雨。找出行动及目的。

自查
先找到答案依据，再用自己的话复述，不要求逐词翻译。

lessons.title: The Bean Plants
lessons.content:
学习目标
定位文中细节，划出支持答案的原句。

原创短文
In science class, Ana and Tom put bean seeds in two cups. They use the same kind of soil and give both cups the same amount of water. Cup A stays by a sunny window. Cup B stays in a dark cupboard. They write down what they see every two days. Their teacher asks them to compare the plants after two weeks.

词汇提示
seed：种子；soil：土壤；amount：数量；compare：比较。

阅读方法
寻找相同和不同条件。本段没有两周后的观察结果，不要用自己的猜测代替文中事实。

自查
先找到答案依据，再用自己的话复述，不要求逐词翻译。
